# Version 4.150.0
> **Filters and raster recovery** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 brings Skia m150, composable image filters, and faster CPU blur rendering.

## Breaking Changes

- **Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs** — Remaining pre-v4 warning-only obsoletes become compile errors. Use GRBackendRenderTarget constructors without sampleCount, run-buffer Glyphs/Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality remain in implementation assemblies for ABI compatibility but are absent from reference assemblies. The two DrawText overloads without explicit SKTextAlign remain warnings. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **Move off notebook integration** — SkiaSharp no longer ships its deprecated .NET Interactive / Polyglot Notebooks extension. Move drawing and display code to a supported application host instead of relying on automatic notebook renderers. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia m150** — Updates the bundled engine to milestone 150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and the existing Windows runtime floor. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146))
- **HarfBuzz 14.2.1** — Refreshes bundled text shaping with AAT, Arabic fallback, COLR v1, and glyph-extents corrections. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## API Surface

- **Composable filter output** — CreateCrop clips filter output with a selectable tile mode; CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))
- **Culling and overdraw diagnostics** — SKPaint.GetFastBounds supports conservative quick-reject culling. SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a caller-supplied six-color palette. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271), [#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))

## Bug Fixes

- **Raster blur and canvas access** — Restores the faster small-sigma CPU blur path and reuses the SKSurface.Canvas wrapper across repeated accesses. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269), [#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))
- **Shared Apple typefaces** — Corrects a race when opening streams from typefaces shared across threads on Apple platforms. ([#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

The collected HarfBuzz-specific work updates the test harness; it does not introduce binding or shaping behavior changes.
